requirements: Add optional event_type filtering to tenant audit pagination. Filter before applying page_size; cursors remain exclusive event IDs and next_cursor is present only when more matching events exist. Omitting event_type retains existing behavior. Repositories return tenant-scoped events ordered by increasing unique integer id. Inputs are well-formed query strings. Repository policy requires function docstrings.
